cases.scenario: A saved fixture plan containing a private marker is readable by an actor explicitly excluded from the artifact policy.
cases.expected_decision: Confirm artifact confidentiality failure and reader path, not credential validity.

cases.scenario: CLI output hides a value while the owner-restricted state intentionally retains it.
cases.expected_decision: Document the behavior; no unauthorized disclosure follows from retention alone.

cases.scenario: A proposed omission control requires a provider feature unavailable in the deployed version.
cases.expected_decision: Keep remediation unverified until compatible behavior and historical artifacts are checked.
